#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int N = 12345;
vector<ll> C(N, 0);
vector<ll> cntA(N, 0);
vector<ll> cntB(N, 0);
ll total;
ll best = 1e18, best_z = -1;
void dfs(ll x, ll y, int v1, int v2)
{
    ll diff = abs(x - y);
    if (best <= 1 || diff - C[v1] * C[v2] >= best) return;
    if (v1 == N - 1 && v2 == N - 1)
    {
        ll diff = abs(x - y);
        if (diff < best)
        {
            best = diff;
            best_z = x;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (v1 >= N)
    {
        ll cur1 = C[v1] - C[v1 - 1];
        ll sum2 = C[v2];
        dfs(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 >= N)
    {
        ll sum1 = C[v1];
        ll cur2 = C[v2] - C[v2 - 1];
        dfs(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
}
ll solve(ll x, ll y, int v1, int v2)
{
    ll state = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
    if (state == 0) return 0;
    ll &res = C[state];
    ll diff = abs(x - y);
    if (diff - C[v1] * C[v2] > best) return 0;
    if (v1 < N || v2 < N)
    {
        if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2])
        {
            int sum = v1 + v2;
            v1 -= cntA[sum];
            v2 -= cntB[sum];
            return C[v1 + v2];
        }
        return 0;
    }
    res = 0;
    char c = ' ';
    if (c != 'B')
    {
        ll cur1 = C[v1] - C[v1 - 1];
        ll sum2 = C[v2];
        res += solve(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (c != 'A')
    {
        ll sum1 = C[v1];
        ll cur2 = C[v2] - C[v2 - 1];
        res += solve(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    return res;
}
int main()
{
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    int r, c;
    cin >> r >> c;
    C[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++)
    {
        C[i] = C[i - 1] + C[i - 1];
    }
    total = C[N - 1] * C[N - 1];
    {
        ll x = 0, y = 0;
        int v1 = N - 1, v2 = N - 1;
        while (v1 >= N && v2 >= N)
        {
            if (x > y)
            {
                ll cur1 = C[v1] - C[v1 - 1];
                ll sum2 = C[v2];
                y += cur1 * sum2;
                v1--;
            }
            else
            {
                ll sum1 = C[v1];
                ll cur2 = C[v2] - C[v2 - 1];
                x += sum1 * cur2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best = abs(x - y);
    }
    dfs(0, 0, N - 1, N - 1);
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    cntA[0] = cntB[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
    {
        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (s[i] == 'A');
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (s[i] == 'B');
    }
    ll ans = solve(0, 0, N - 1, N - 1);
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
